content: Within six months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to grasp and release small objects into a container in 4 out of 5 opportunities with minimal assistance, enhancing fine motor dexterity during play tasks.

Within six months, Sabrina will successfully navigate an obstacle course with age-appropriate obstacles, completing the course with no more than 2 verbal prompts in 4 out of 5 trials, to improve gross motor coordination and balance.

Within three months, Sabrina will participate in a structured group play activity, engaging with peers for at least 10 minutes with minimal adult facilitation, to enhance social participation and cooperative play skills.

Within four months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to trace basic shapes (circle, square) using a crayon with moderate cues, accomplishing this task in 3 out of 5 opportunities, thereby enhancing visual-motor integration and pre-writing skills.

Within five months, Sabrina will use both hands together to hold a toy and remove a lid from a container in 4 out of 5 attempts independently, to improve bilateral coordination and midline crossing abilities.
Within six months, Sabrina will select and eat a variety of textures and food types with minimal prompts during 5 out of 6 meals, to foster sensory processing and adaptive eating behaviors.

Within three months, Sabrina will put on and take off a simple piece of clothing (e.g., hat, jacket) with minimal assistance in 4 out of 5 opportunities, improving self-care and independence in dressing tasks.

Within six months, Sabrina will participate in a sensory-rich activity (e.g., sandbox play) for at least 5 minutes with appropriate sensory regulation in 4 out of 5 sessions, with minimal adult support, to increase sensory exploration and engagement.
